render-mode.text:
📥 Import — quick help (click to hide / show)
Add the products you sell.
1 Add Single Product for one item (search first to edit an existing one — it auto-fills the SKU).
2 Bulk Import to paste rows or upload a CSV — follow the column format shown.
3 Recently added / updated items appear at the bottom.

container.style: zenith-card bg-white shadow-2 q-pa-md q-mb-md border-radius-lg

label.text: Search to edit an existing item (auto-fills the SKU), or fill the fields to add a new one.

render-mode.text: Adding a new product

container.style: zenith-card bg-white shadow-2 q-pa-md q-mb-md border-radius-lg

label.text: Choose a CSV file (loaded into the box below) or paste rows, then Import. Existing products (matched by SKU) are updated.

render-mode.text:
Column Required Description
SKUYesUnique product code
ProductNameYesProduct display name
DescriptionNoProduct description
ListPriceNoSelling price charged at POS
MRPNoMaximum retail price
ProductTaxCodeNoTax code (HSN/SAC)
ReorderPointNoLow stock alert level
ReorderQuantityNoQuantity to reorder
ExpiryDateNoPerishable goods expiry, format YYYY-MM-DD (shows in Wastage)
UnitNokg, g, l, ml or pcs (loose/weighed goods). Blank = piece.
